goal.statement: Write the first draft of my non-fiction book

why: I've carried this idea for five years. I want to know if it holds up on paper.

blocker.note: I research endlessly and rewrite chapter 1.

path.primary: Daily 45-minute drafting sessions, no editing until the draft is done
path.parallel: One reading session a week (research, capped)
guardrails: No rewriting earlier chapters until the full draft exists

lanes.name: Write
starter_actions: Open the draft and type one sentence

ritual.trigger: After I sit down with my first coffee, I open the draft, before email.
ritual.warmup: Re-read the last paragraph I wrote yesterday
ritual.shutdown: Leave a half-finished sentence for tomorrow

if_then.if: I want to fix an earlier chapter
if_then.then: add a note in [brackets] and keep going
write [TK] and look it up on research day

checkpoints.label: Month 3
checkpoints.rethink_if: fewer than 5 chapters → shrink the scope or the outline
checkpoints.ask: Is the outline still the book I want to write?

first_action.text: Write the first sentence of the chapter you're most excited about

compass:
WHY: find out if the idea holds up on paper.
HOW: 45 minutes before email, drafting only; research is capped at once a week.
RULE: no rewriting until the draft is done.
